description:
Observability & cost governance (Stage 18, final stage of the 18-week plan):
        boundary-captured metrics, multi-dimensional budgets, explainable model routing, evaluation
        regression, version provenance. Metrics live at the decorator boundary, not in the loop path
        (blueprint D2); one run, three projections - Trajectory (training, Stage 14) / AuditEvent
        (governance, Stage 9) / Metrics (operations, Stage 18) share the same boundaries (blueprint D1).
